item.title: Mass Media Deputy Minister visits Lake House
item.description: Mass Media Deputy Minister Dr. Kaushalya Ariyarathne visited Lake House today after assuming duties in her new post. She also inspected various departments at the institution. Here, the Deputy Minister inspecting the operations at the press department with Operations Director Chamara Janaraj Peiris explaining its functions.
